coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping during the overnight hours, with the fan running on low to keep the bedroom comfortable in the warm night air
Waking up, using the toilet, brushing teeth and taking a cool shower to freshen up before the hot day
Making and eating breakfast, boiling the kettle for tea and toasting bread, then rinsing the dishes quickly
Getting dressed in work clothes, packing a water bottle and small lunch, and checking the phone for the heatwave warning and hospital shift notes
Commuting to the hospital for the day shift, travelling in the cooler early morning hours
Working a daytime shift as a health care professional, caring for patients, checking observations, administering medication, updating records and taking short hydration breaks
Commuting home after the shift, travelling during the hottest part of the day
Taking a cool shower to wash off the day and cool down, then changing into light casual clothes
Cooking a simple dinner using the induction cooker and range hood, eating it at the kitchen bench with cold water
Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher, wiping down the counters and putting leftovers in the refrigerator
Relaxing on the couch watching the TV with the fan on, deliberately avoiding air-conditioner use during the evening peak tax period, and reviewing the next day's roster on the computer
Completing the night routine: washing face, brushing teeth and using the toilet before bed
Sleeping, with the fan circulating air in the bedroom and the desk lamp switched off
